description: Commercial capabilities an establishment can hold. Implemented by domain::entitlements::Capability; tests enforce parity. Capabilities are granted by catalog offers (modules or add-ons) and never by plan names.

capabilities.summary: Publish or republish the static public menu snapshot (first publication and live updates).
Publish the white-label ordering storefront and its versioned catalog snapshot.
Accept new delivery or pickup orders from consumers.
Accept, reject and progress delivery and pickup orders.
Manage delivery zones, fees, minimum order, coupons and service modes.
Open table sessions and handle waiter calls; transfers and closing use tables.bill.manage.
Create in-venue orders from a controlled table session.
Close, split and settle table bills.
Create production tickets manually or from orders.
Progress production tickets and item states on the kitchen display.
Configure kitchen sectors, stations and routing rules.
Register deliveries, including ones originating outside QR Cardápio.
Assign deliveries to couriers and track their progress.
Manage couriers, availability and operational payouts.
Credit and debit loyalty points; reversals stay available after expiry.
Configure rewards, campaigns and redemptions.
Advanced cross-channel reports and period comparisons.
Import historical sales from CSV.
Register counter sales with non-fiscal receipts.
Open cash register sessions and register withdrawals and supplies; closing stays available after expiry.
Use the versioned commercial REST API with scoped credentials.
Manage outbound webhooks to external systems.
Serve public pages from an establishment-owned domain.

reclassified.decision: Merged into menu.publish. Owners update a live menu by republishing; draft editing is a free QR Core catalog operation and was never gated.
Reclassified as a free QR Core operation. QR codes point to the permanent /c/{slug} URL and were generated without a subscription before this change; gating them would break existing customers.
